role: Independent source/measurement verifier, not data custodian or model executor

decision.meaning: Neither named candidate is eligible for fitting, export, or scientific authorization under the inspected protocol and current source inventory. This is a source-eligibility decision, not a scored biological failure.

verdict_semantics.PASS: The explicitly scoped source fact or measurement classification was independently established. PASS for semantics or source identity does not authorize a train/test projection.
verdict_semantics.FAIL: The stated projection or interpretation conflicts with primary evidence or cannot meet a specific registered requirement using the available identified units.
verdict_semantics.UNVERIFIED: Necessary evidence, exact source mapping, or access is missing. This is not zero, absence, independence, or permission to infer a convenient value.
verdict_semantics.original_measurement: Instrument observations from an experiment, before any claim that a derived biological quantity was directly observed.
verdict_semantics.derived_measurement: An explicitly documented transformation of instrument observations, such as an intensity ratio, calibrated concentration, or fitted initial slope. Its calibration, denominator, uncertainty and experimental unit remain part of the measurement.
verdict_semantics.inferred_quantity: A model-dependent flux, kinetic constant, imputation, prediction, or physiological bound. It is not experimental ground truth merely because it is packaged with measurements.

facts: FY derivatives: DBY11069 (MATa) for carbon/nitrogen/phosphorus limitation; DBY11167 (MATa leu2Delta1) for leucine; DBY7284 (MATa ura3-52) for uracil. These IDs directly identify Boer cultures; correspondence to each later Hackett culture still needs original sample records.

Mineral media are referred to Supplemental Table S4. The inspected Methods specify continuous chemostats and pH 5.0, but do not establish a culture temperature. The LC-MS autosampler temperature is not a culture temperature.
Four sampling occasions over two days from each experimental chemostat, paired to two phosphorus-limited reference cultures, yield repeated ratios, not eight independent experimental cultures.
Relative concentrations use volume-normalized ion counts and date/extraction-method-matched phosphorus references. Near-limit/non-detected signals are floored in the published preprocessing.
The heat-map representation is log2 transformed and mean-centered across all conditions. It is not an untouched absolute concentration table.

primary_sources.kind: Primary Methods for a later-received alternative, not a selected replacement
facts: CEN.PK113-7D haploid prototrophic cells are grown in aerobic glucose-limited defined-mineral-medium chemostats and transferred for nitrogen-starvation experiments. These are not Hackett FY cultures.

A separate five-second 14C-glucose zero-trans uptake assay at 30 C is an original transport measurement; nonlinear Michaelis-Menten fitting is a subsequent inference, not another independent uptake observation.

NAD(P)H-linked activities are measured at 30 C in freshly prepared cell-free extracts under a standardized in-vivo-like buffer. They are mixed-extract activities, not purified-enzyme or active-site-normalized turnover.
Substrate/coupling recipes are referred to Text S1. Exact response-table denominator, original preparation identities, uncertainties and a primary assay pH were not established in this review.

quantity_reviews.classification: Model-inferred internal flux and FVA interval, not an original reaction-rate assay
quantity_reviews.root_cause: Modified YEASTNET stoichiometry/directionality, fitted boundary constraints, penalties and FVA produce the label. Authors' naming of an experimentally observed range does not change its derivation. A new law trained on it would be learning an inherited model target, not a measured Cdc19 law.
additional_limits: FVA is a model feasibility range, not a measured sampling-confidence interval.
Cdc19-specific attribution is not a direct assay of Cdc19 flux versus minor isozymes.
No source-bound conversion from the deposited rate denominator to the protocol dry-biomass denominator was established.

quantity_reviews.classification: NMR concentrations are derived experimental measurements; their dilution/volume-derived net exchange is not a single-enzyme rate
quantity_reviews.verified_definition: Spent-medium peaks normalized to DSS and compared with external standards; uptake/excretion obtained from medium concentration changes and dilution, with the cell/culture volume or biomass denominator retained.
quantity_reviews.experimental_unit: One chemostat culture; two medium samples are sampling/technical repeats, not independent cultures.
quantity_reviews.root_cause: Original per-sample spectral/medium records, analyte-specific calibration, concentration and rate units, exact culture IDs, denominator and uncertainty lineage have not been source-bound. The binary boundaryFluxes object was not deserialized here. Boundary exchange cannot replace the registered intracellular pyruvate-kinase observable.

quantity_reviews.classification: Mixture of approximations, free model exchanges and derived/model-assumed biomass demands
quantity_reviews.root_cause: Oxygen is constructed from an RQ approximation; CO2 is free exchange; biomass monomer proportions and energetic demands include assumptions. The code also removes an actual phosphate constraint. A generic boundary-flux label cannot certify an original assay for each quantity.

quantity_reviews.classification: Derived relative isotope-reference protein abundance, with some model-imputed entries
quantity_reviews.unit_class: Relative light/heavy peptide-ion-current representation; Methods use log2 ratios, peptide aggregation and reference normalization, not mol/L or active sites per biomass.
quantity_reviews.reference: Equal total extracted protein mixed with a 15N-labeled reference made from two phosphate-limited cultures.
quantity_reviews.experimental_unit: One biological culture per condition, measured in technical triplicate.
quantity_reviews.root_cause: The table header does not identify absolute enzyme amount, active fraction, original peptide-to-protein mapping or which entries were kNN-imputed. Exact per-cell measured-versus-imputed provenance is needed before admitting an all-measured input projection.

quantity_reviews.classification: Unidentified biological quantities, not determined by relative proteomics or a fitted gain
quantity_reviews.root_cause: Relative abundance, total extracted protein and model-fitted scaling do not identify target active-enzyme concentration. Denaturing extraction and isotope-ratio measurement cannot establish catalytic active fraction.

quantity_reviews.classification: Derived relative metabolomics, with absolute calibration for a stated subset and reused prior-culture measurements
sources: B_METHODS:Sampling and Extraction,LC-MS/MS Analysis,Normalization and Clustering
quantity_reviews.absolute_calibration: Hackett #S29 describes commercial-standard calibration for 56 metabolites, using labeled phosphate-limited samples for nitrogen-containing metabolites and a batch-culture reference route for other metabolites. This is not a blanket absolute-unit certificate for every table entry.
quantity_reviews.compartment: Whole-cell/cellular-volume-normalized measurements; compartment-specific free concentrations not established.
quantity_reviews.root_cause: Need exact metabolite IDs, source tables and cells, calibration lineage, units, detection-floor treatment, technical-sampling IDs and original culture-to-later-condition mapping. Boer heat-map centering across all conditions must not silently become training-only normalization.

quantity_reviews.classification: Nominal-condition-matched measurements from different culture sets plus an inferred flux
quantity_reviews.root_cause: Primary Methods explicitly distinguish the prior metabolomics culture from the later proteomics/fluxomics culture. Joining a condition label does not make simultaneous or same-biological-culture observations. Technical replicates and shared reference cultures cannot repair this claim.

quantity_reviews.classification: Direct/coupled experimental reaction-progress measurements with blank-subtracted fitted initial slopes; not the SIMMER kinetic fit
quantity_reviews.protein: N-terminal His-tagged S. cerevisiae Cdc19 obtained via the cited Xu 2012 preparation; affinity purification and SDS-PAGE are described. Exact prior construct/preparation lineage and active-site concentration remain unverified.
quantity_reviews.assay_context: Tris/MgCl2/KCl buffer with PEP and ADP; NADH/LDH-coupled 340-nm readout and a separate direct 232-nm PEP-to-pyruvate readout. Reaction progress recorded for one hour; initial slopes and enzyme-free blanks, not a one-hour endpoint relabeled as an initial rate.
quantity_reviews.source_readout_units: Absorbance versus time; rate derivation needs assay geometry/extinction/path length and enzyme dose where applicable.
quantity_reviews.root_cause: No original assay table, plate/well/preparation IDs, replicate lineage, raw rate units or uncertainty records were obtained. Six independent matched preparations are not established. Purified tagged protein in assay buffer is not identical to the native chemostat intracellular context.
quantity_reviews.selection_history: #S44 explicitly says these assays tested predictions selected by the original authors. Reusing known assay-supported targets/hypotheses is replication, not blind new discovery.

quantity_reviews.classification: Authors' inferred kinetic parameters, selected model forms and predictions

The authors also selected some condition subsets using observed data. No fitted parameter, inferred flux midpoint, selected regulator, or best-fit curve is an independent label for a new law learner.

quantity_reviews.classification: Initial absorbance slopes are derived assay measurements; fitted kcat/Km or model predictions are inferred summaries, not those original observations
quantity_reviews.raw_readout_unit: Absorbance at 340 nm versus time; quantitative rate-unit adapter not established
quantity_reviews.enzyme_amount_basis: BCA-estimated total purified tagged preparation, not active-site titration
quantity_reviews.root_cause: No source-bound raw initial-rate/timecourse table, independent preparation IDs or matched FY-culture support exists in this review. quantity_reviews.classification: Cell-free-extract NAD(P)H-linked activity and separate original short-interval glucose uptake; fitted transport kinetics are inferred, not raw uptake
quantity_reviews.culture: CEN.PK113-7D, defined mineral medium, glucose-limited and nitrogen-starvation contexts
quantity_reviews.root_cause: Mixed extract does not identify an enzyme-specific active amount. Original replicate-level activity/uptake records, the exact denominator and uncertainty remain unverified, and this strain/starvation context is not matched Hackett FY support.

quantity_reviews.classification: Image-derived intensity summaries and their dimensionless ratio, not an absolute protein or phosphorylation measurement
quantity_reviews.raw_intensity_units: Uncalibrated instrument intensity units; absolute photons or molecular counts not established.
quantity_reviews.root_cause: The ratio measures spatial concentration of GFP signal under the documented segmentation/projection procedure. It is not an absolute nuclear fraction, and valid positive denominators and per-row quality have not been inspected in this metadata-only review.

quantity_reviews.classification: Response-derived per-experiment normalization, not an identity/unit adapter
quantity_reviews.root_cause: The published transformation estimates an offset and scale from heldout-experiment pre-stress response measurements. The current identity-transform protocol does not permit this as a fixed unit conversion. The example code's SD/window convention differs from a naive pooled-SD reading, and interpolation/filtering/export lineage is incomplete.
quantity_reviews.important_correction: Primary SI does not support alleging future-peak or whole-trace min-max normalization. The verified problem is per-experiment pre-stress normalization and unresolved exact export lineage.
quantity_reviews.noninvertibility_evidence: The deposited normalized Sfp1 rep1 has shape 164x96 while its documented raw counterpart is 158x97; normalization constants, row identities and raw replicate-2 intensities are not present.

quantity_reviews.classification: Unmeasured quantities incorrectly substituted for a localization proxy
quantity_reviews.root_cause: No phospho-specific assay, active-enzyme calibration, metabolite/product flux assay or absolute protein calibration is supplied by these imaging summaries. A [0,1] phosphorylation bound is inappropriate for max5/median.

quantity_reviews.classification: GFP target intensities in regions segmented using an additional Nhp6A-mCherry marker; empirical localization support, not an independent protein-activity assay
quantity_reviews.medium: SC, glucose downshift to 0.1% as documented
quantity_reviews.root_cause: The current projection does not establish six independent matched Sfp1 support acquisitions, uncertainty, original masks or disjoint original movie/day IDs. The same GFP pixels contribute to different summaries; the mCherry marker adds a spatial reference, not independent catalytic information.
quantity_reviews.source_history: These experiments were used by the original authors to choose/validate adoption of the proxy. Reusing that published justification is not a blind independent discovery test. A separately acquired support experiment could be useful only with its own verified lineage and a prefrozen adapter.

quantity_reviews.classification: Stimulus-relative acquisition metadata, not a verified absolute-clock intervention design
quantity_reviews.origin_semantics: Deposited origin is an integer; the authors' example uses it as an array transition index. Do not subtract that integer as though it were a physical time in minutes from times already relative to the switch.
quantity_reviews.root_cause: Actual per-group time vectors, absolute start timestamps, device/day IDs, and independent crossing of acquisition clock with stimulus are not source-bound here. quantity_reviews.classification: Direct radiolabeled product assay expressed as an extract-normalized average activity, not purified-enzyme kcat
quantity_reviews.pH_note: E. coli extraction buffer is MOPS pH 7.5; the activity recipe does not explicitly state assay pH. These are not interchangeable facts.
quantity_reviews.denominator: Total soluble protein extract, not quantified active CrtE

quantity_reviews.replication: Two independent culture extracts, two assays per extract; four assays are not four biological cultures.
quantity_reviews.root_cause: The assay supports reaction identity and a reported extract-level activity. Intrinsic turnover, initial-rate linearity, active fraction and target-host enzyme abundance are not established. The subsequent 37 C acid hydrolysis is not the enzyme assay temperature.

quantity_reviews.classification: Unjustified cross-host/denominator transfer
quantity_reviews.root_cause: Mixed E. coli extract activity, protein size and gene copy count do not determine active fungal enzyme mass or target-strain in-vivo capacity. No strain/sequence, promoter, compartment or active-fraction equivalence was established.

quantity_reviews.classification: Protein detection/identification in another expression system, not active-enzyme quantification
quantity_reviews.root_cause: OD-normalized denatured lysates, Western detection and peptide identification do not provide calibrated target active-enzyme mass. quantity_reviews.root_cause: The current native-law sources do not establish these facts. Prior abstract-only or automated-annotation statements, inaccessible primary bodies, bacterial comparators and copied metadata cannot upgrade the missing fungal measurements. biological_unit_rules: Random cells, time points, channels, technical extracts and repeated injections are not independent biological replicates.
Different shapes or unequal hashes cannot prove independence: cropping, segmentation, filtering or normalization can change a representation of the same experiment.
Shared five-chamber Granados device/media delivery, day/batch and movie dependencies need original acquisition identifiers. A factor-specific array is not a verified independent device run.

Hackett/Boer per-condition technical repeats, shared isotope-reference pools and date-matched metabolomics references require a calibration/dependency graph and correlated-error accounting. Do not assume 25 independent joint same-culture triplets.
A new split does not erase earlier source-template, feature, normalization, hypothesis or upstream calibration exposure.

G_SI:3.1 and G_CODE show experiment-level response normalization; B_METHODS shows shared references and all-condition heat-map centering.

root_causes: Even the generous named-group upper bound fails the frozen split rule before unknown overlaps reduce it further.
